findings.description: Direct inspection of the current front, back, side, three-quarter, and six pose renders shows strong angular faceting and wrinkled clumps across the skirt, with uneven, pointed split-front edges. The overall skirt silhouette is not visually continuous.

Current sit and crouch renders expose large rounded shorts-like thigh shells through and ahead of the overskirt. The front lap/apron panels separate into narrow pointed flaps and leave the seated anterior thighs visibly uncovered; the current pose geometry is not acceptable.

The rear waist adjustment tab is only a small, low-contrast shape in the full-body back view and is not visually legible as a distinct functional-looking detail. It needs a readable silhouette and close-up evidence.

Direct raster inspection of the source-bound partial UV chart shows dense near-continuous vertical line stacks crossing the unit tile, with panel islands crowded and difficult to distinguish. This is not a reviewable production UV layout. The chart contains only authored UVs from 21/25 mesh objects; the plastron and three front fasteners are explicitly unmapped and omitted. No UV coordinates were generated or substituted.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V40 preserves canonical sewn-vertex provenance through bounded cleanup and cloth splitting. The current weighted 3D renders still show strong skirt faceting/clumping, broken anterior coverage in sit/crouch, and an illegible rear tab. A source-bound partial UV showcase now carries authored panel UVs through the split and records 21 mapped / 4 unmapped objects; no UV coordinates were auto-generated. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified.
sourceEvidence.uvMappingStatus: AUTHORED_PANEL_UVS_PRESERVED; DIRECT REVIEW REJECTED: DENSE/OVERLAPPING CHART; PARTIAL 21/25 OBJECTS; 4 UNMAPPED

nextAction: Rework authored pattern UV sizing/packing from the canonical source so panel islands have readable, non-overlapping occupancy; create/author UVs for the plastron and fastener pieces only if those meshes receive real product texture coordinates. Also revise skirt drape, sit/crouch anterior coverage, rounded thigh-shell volume, and rear-tab legibility, then rebuild and inspect source-bound pose and UV output.
